scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,app "vite --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on tcp:5173 && node scripts/py.mjs main.py --dev"
scripts.dev:android: node scripts/android-setup.mjs && concurrently -k -n web,android "vite --host --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on tcp:5173 && npx cap run android -l --external --port 5173"
scripts.build:apk: vite build && node scripts/android-setup.mjs && npx cap sync android && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleRelease
scripts.build:apk:debug: vite build && node scripts/android-setup.mjs && npx cap sync android && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
